title: CorPatch®: Does training with a pocket trainer improve the resuscitation skills of laypeople?
summary: The aim of the study is to test whether training with a resuscitation feedback device lowers the barriers for laypersons to initiate resuscitation. To this end, questionnaires will be used and a resuscitation feedback device will be given for 3 months to test and practise at home.
conditions: Low bystander resuscitation rate in Germany

interventions.name:
Laypersons train with CorPatch® once a week for 2 minutes for 12 weeks
intervention group: 
- Filling out the questionnaire at the beginning of the study 
- Train once a week for 2 minutes using CorPatch®

Control group:
- Completion of the questionnaire at the beginning of the study 
- On the day of training, resuscitation with a CorPatch® trainer 
- After training, complete the questionnaire again

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Voluntary participation
Exclusion criteria:
- <18 years
- Legal representation
- Physically unable to perform resuscitation
